# rapsimng.fababean

Fababean model for APSIM Next Generation.

## Installation

Currently on [Github](https://github.com/byzheng/rapsimng.fababean)
only. Install with:

``` r

remotes::install_github('byzheng/rapsimng.fababean')
```

## Documentation

For detailed documentation and reference, visit:
<https://fababean.rapsimng.bangyou.me>

# Package index

## All functions

- [`fababean`](https://fababean.rapsimng.bangyou.me/reference/fababean.md)
  : fababean model options manager
- [`thermal_time()`](https://fababean.rapsimng.bangyou.me/reference/thermal_time.md)
  : Calculate thermal time using cardinal temperatures
- [`vernalisation_days()`](https://fababean.rapsimng.bangyou.me/reference/vernalisation_days.md)
  : Calculate vernalisation time using cardinal temperatures
